title: Factory
summary: Hide which concrete type is built, in one place the caller can find.

parts.rule: Put construction of variant types behind one factory the caller already knows how to find.
parts.why: Scattered new Foo() locks callers to concrete classes and duplicates branching.
parts.example: SAMPLE: a notifier factory returns email or push implementations from a config flag; callers only depend on the notifier interface.
parts.use: Use when several concrete types share a create site and the choice should not leak.
parts.refuse: Refuse a factory that only wraps a single concrete with no variation. Refuse global service locators pretending to be factories.

body:
Rule. Put construction of variant types behind one factory the caller already knows how to find.

Why it matters. Scattered new Foo() locks callers to concrete classes and duplicates branching.

SAMPLE example. SAMPLE: a notifier factory returns email or push implementations from a config flag; callers only depend on the notifier interface.

When to use. Use when several concrete types share a create site and the choice should not leak.

When to refuse. Refuse a factory that only wraps a single concrete with no variation. Refuse global service locators pretending to be factories.
